integrity: Standalone proof with independently run finite exact and numerical diagnostics. Finite checks are not universal proofs. No independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only leaf-only metrics of weighted stars with exactly two positive arm-length classes each containing at least two leaves. Excludes centers, other topologies and three-or-more length classes. Bibliographic priority not independently established.
title: Two-class leaf metrics: sharp Euclidean window and asymmetric roundness blow-up
